Done! I've added the `uniqueIds(ids)` function to src/importer.js. It:

- Takes an array of IDs
- Uses a `Set` to track seen values
- Filters out duplicates while preserving first-seen order
- Is exported alongside the existing `parseIds` function

The function works by checking each ID against a Set of previously encountered IDs—if it's new, it's included and added to the Set; if already seen, it's filtered out.
